parent_objective: design concrete numeric env overlays for reset-blocked stable/AES support work items before reset or measured rollout
blocked_by: M2458 reset-required stable/AES work items lack concrete numeric env overlays
reset validation remains blocked until overlay ranges are designed and materialized
actor-input and no-ranking guardrails must be preserved
supersedes: direct reset from reset-blocked work items
direct measured rollout without concrete overlay design

public_gates: M2460 must define a concrete numeric overlay contract for the six reset-blocked stable/AES work items
M2460 must keep labels and hidden metadata metadata-only and out of actor input
M2460 must preserve handling-limit, hidden-dynamics, geometry/timing, and mitigation guardrails
M2460 must select a bounded materialization/preflight route or stop without reset, rollout, repair, training, ranking, winner, or verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not rank scenario candidates as winners
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the concrete numeric overlay contract needed before reset validation of stable/AES scenario-quality support work items
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design-only concrete overlay contract; no reset, rollout, policy action, scenario-redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if overlay ranges cannot be defined without actor-input leakage
stop if overlay keys would require hidden/oracle actor features
stop if guardrail rows cannot be preserved
stop if the next route would execute measured rollout without overlay materialization and reset preflight
fallback_plan: route to overlay materialization/preflight if the contract is concrete
route to branch synthesis if the contract remains broad
stop for user review if claim boundaries are violated

allowed_updates: M2460 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: concrete overlay schema and ranges are defined
bounded materialization/preflight route is selected or route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2460 designs scenario-quality overlays and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2460; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If concrete overlays cannot be designed safely, classify it as scenario-spec readiness rather than driver failure.
allowed_claims: no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns reset-blocked evidence into a concrete numeric overlay contract
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit overlay materialization/preflight or force synthesis/stop
must_synthesize_if: another design-only route is proposed after M2460 without implementation
the next route would execute measured rollout directly

hypothesis: A design-only concrete overlay contract can define the numeric scenario ranges needed to unblock reset preflight for stable/AES work items without actor-input leakage or unsupported verdict claims.
success_criteria: the design defines required overlay fields and bounded ranges for stable/AES reset-required work items
the design preserves guardrail roles and claim boundaries
a bounded materialization/preflight route is selected or the route is stopped
no reset rollout scenario-redesign execution repair training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2460 resets environment or executes policy action
M2460 executes scenario redesign, repair, or training
M2460 ranks scenario candidates, candidate families, controllers, selected checkpoints, or panel rows as winners
M2460 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign, or training-repair verdict claims
decision_rule: M2460 passes if it writes a concrete overlay design and selects a bounded materialization/preflight route or stops without reset, rollout, scenario redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
